periods.label: Fri 6 Nov
periods.text: Northeasterly 15 to 20 knots. Around 1 metre. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres. Mostly clear.

periods.label: Sat 7 Nov
periods.text: Northwest to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots tending west to northwesterly before dawn then turning south to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots in the late morning. Winds reaching up to 30 knots during the afternoon and evening. Squalls possible with the wind change. 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres around midday, then increasing to 2.5 to 3 metres during the afternoon. Southerly around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres around midday. Partly cloudy. 95% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm with possible squalls.

periods.label: Sun 8 Nov
periods.text: Southwesterly 25 to 30 knots turning southerly in the early morning. 2.5 to 3 metres. Southerly 1.5 to 2.5 metres. Cloudy. 90% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore in the morning.

periods.label: Mon 9 Nov
periods.text: Southerly 20 to 30 knots decreasing to 10 to 15 knots during the evening. 1.5 to 2.5 metres. Southerly 2.5 to 3 metres, tending southeasterly 2.5 to 4 metres during the morning. Cloudy. 60% chance of showers. Large and powerful surf conditions are expected to be hazardous for coastal activities such as crossing bars by boat and rock fishing.

periods.label: Fri 6 Nov

Partly cloudy. 50% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the morning and afternoon. Possible squalls with thunderstorms offshore north of Yamba in the early morning.

periods.label: Mon 9 Nov

Large and powerful surf conditions are expected to be hazardous for coastal activities such as crossing bars by boat and rock fishing.
